articleTitle: Energy Harvesting in RFID Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Energy harvesting for wireless sensors and RFID smart tags is a critical design feature on the path to the grand vision of ubiquitous computing. An important subset of energy harvesting solutions is the use of the RF reader signal to deliver energy and power up smart RFID tag circuitry. This paper focuses on the design of multi-stage voltage rectifiers and the power management strategies needed to power the large loads associated with sensors and microcontrollers integrated into the RFID tag

articleTitle: Sensor Applications in RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology is rapidly evolving. It has the potential to become a key element of ubiquitous sensing and ubiquitous computing solutions. The paper offers a brief overview of research directions, most promising applications, and technical challenges in this field

articleTitle: A Finite Element Method in Electrodynamics. Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A vector finite element method for electrodynamics problems is described. In spite of high universality and effectiveness the method suffers from slow convergence and high solution time. So a number of algorithms intended to cure these disadvantages are described, among them potential formulation of basic equation, adaptive meshers, higher order basis functions, orthogonalization, fast frequency sweep, parallel computations and some other algorithms are described

articleTitle: Temperature Field Distribution in Sheet Materials in Microwave Heating Waveguide Devices
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The calculation and designing method for waveguide type microwave devices is offered for flat dielectric materials heat treatment. Microwave devices, which discriminating particularity is a change of the rectangular waveguide wall geometric sizes for the reason ensuring the even warm-up field in processed flat dielectric materials are considered. The calculation and measurement results of the temperature field distribution in flat dielectric materials are considered. The method of the geometric to specific power of the losses from square of the tension of the electric field in volume of the processed material is offered. sizes rectangular waveguide broad and narrow walls adjustment, which is based on dependencies

articleTitle: Frequency Agile Signal Processing in Direct Conversion Software Radio
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Problems resulting from having multiple frequency bands as well as different communication standards make it impossible for the current generation of analog systems to interoperate. Providing all signal processing in software by converting received signals into digital form immediately after an antenna produces a new qualitative leap in frequency agility as well as protocol standard independence. It solves the problem of system interoperability in a highly fragmented communication environment. However to realize all the potential benefits of direct conversion radio a few vital signal processing problems originating from the specifics of software radio have to be addressed. The offered paper describes direct conversion software radio problems and shows potential ways of their solution

articleTitle: Analysis by Multiconductor Line Method of the Piezoelectric Travelling Wave Transducer in the Form of Flat Meander with Oneside Arrangement of Piezocapacistance Loadings
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The problem about the analysis of the basic dispersive characteristics of the multielement electro-acoustic travelling wave piezotransducer prepared in the form of a flat conducting tape meander with oneside arrangement of piezocapacitance loadings is put forward. The method of multiconducter lines allow to find the dispersive equations for phase shift and expression for definition of wave resistance. There are presented results of calculations of these values in the forms curves for a concrete set of initial parameters of these piezotransducers

articleTitle: Approximate Value of High Level Harmonic Components in PPM Focusing System
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The approximate paraxial solution of Laplac equation for scalar magnetic potential in PPM focusing system is presented. High level of harmonic components in PPM focusing system with multiple-harmonic magnetic field distribution may be realized

articleTitle: About Limit Excel the Power, That Make Clystron-Tube Over Power Clystrode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: This paper demonstrates that theoretical power klystrone-tube is able to make 1.8 times higher power than klystrode

articleTitle: The Checking of Temperature Stability of Magnetically Hard Material by Means Teslameter of Type H1-8
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: For magnetic measurements serial teslameter type H1-8 in a range (100divide110) mT1 that has an error no more plusmn0,15 % is used. For the operative temperature stability checking in a range of temperatures (18divide100) degC of magnets to be used in microwave devices the new method and additional device were developed. The magnets from alloy CS-25 of different manufactures have disorder of values of reversible temperature coefficient of an induction from - 1,9 % up to - 4,8 % on 100degC as has been shown. The effect of samples form on measurements is not shown

articleTitle: Analysis, Synthesis, Optimization, and Heuristics of Floating-Drift Klystron in High Level of Parameters
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Applications of analysis, synthesis and optimization of floating-drift klystron in high level of parameters have been revised. Heuristic approach, which allows carry out synthesis of an optimum clot in klystron and realize the corresponding regime at producing of device with the record electronic efficiency of 90 %, is given. Our result also showed that the amplification's band could be in several times increased when reduce electronic efficiency to 60% in that band

articleTitle: Increasing of Magnetic Field Parameter in PPM Focusing System with Nonharmonical Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The conditions of stable electron beam focusing in PPM with high magnetic field parameter and a high harmonic component are found. Comparison of ideal and experimental PPM focusing system cells with required magnetic field distribution is shown

articleTitle: Wiener Spectrum Analysis of Fluctuations of Light, Passed Through a Blood Smear, Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analysis has been made of Wiener spectrum behavior of fluctuations of light flow through a blood smear depending on the form, the sizes, the number and the transparence of erythrocytes - one of the blood form elements

articleTitle: Analytic Method of Calculation the Maximum Energy Parameters of Multibeam Klystrode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The problems of construction the mathematical model that describes a klystrode output energy operation factors is considered. This mathematical model will be use in an online analysis program for optimization its parameters

articleTitle: The Electrodynamics Characteristics of Waveguide Partly Filled by Inhomogeneous Photo Induced Semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The process of interaction between electromagnetic radiation at millimetric and submillimetric wavelength range and photo induced inhomogeneous semiconductor plasma is considered. Under VKB assumption and diffusion equation, the complex dispersion equation is derived which determines attenuation and phase of electromagnetic wave in dependence on intensity of laser radiation, electromagnetic wave frequency, surface recombination rate and thickness of the semiconductor to be filled in the waveguide

articleTitle: Influence of Azimuthal Non-Uniform Magnetic Field on Character of Movement in the Magnetic Diode with the Crossed Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The analysis of influence of a magnetic field on character of movement of the charged particles in the magnetic diode is lead. On the basis of the analysis of cards of dynamic parameters changes of areas of chaotic behavior of electrons for various kinds' heterogeneity of magnetic field are certain

articleTitle: Barium Activity and Emissive Properties of Composite Oxides
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The influence of temperature and composition of BaO CaO SrO connection-oriented oxide-cathodes and BaO CaO Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3 </sub> connection-oriented aluminate cathodes on barium activity at free vacuum evaporation of oxides is examined. The increase of concentration of more stable oxides in comparison with baryta (CaO, SrO)) decreases the activity of oxygen and increase of barium activity. On the contrary, the additions of less stable oxides (<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) increase oxygen activity and reduce barium activity. For receiving of the equal emission of various oxides the barium activity in them should be identical (about 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>). The increased barium activity in triple oxide is the evidence of the tendency to education of nucleus pure barium

articleTitle: Vacuum Technology as Basis for Production of Vacuum Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: State-of-the art technologies which have been worked out for manufacture of vacuum tubes, mainly high-power microwave devices, proved to be a decisive feature shaping technical standard of vacuum circuit breakers production

articleTitle: Microstrip Transformers - Lowpass Filters on Resonance Sections of Comb Slow - Wave Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of resonance sections of comb slow-wave structures application for microstrip transformers-lowpass filters are considered. The advantages of such systems in comparison to the systems manufactured on the base of usual transmission lines are shown

articleTitle: Nonlinear Interaction of Charges in the Magnetron Diode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The model of cooperating charges in the magnetron diode is submitted in the article. The influence of an exponentionally varied magnetic field on character of their movement is considered. The Liapunov parameters are used as an estimation of a degree of a chaos of system

articleTitle: The Wavelet Transform Application in Reconstruction of the Information Sent Through Long Line
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article describes new possibilities of the correct information highlighting from the communication channel. The mathematical Simulink model of the device for radio-frequency signal shaping and its transceiving through the long line was created. The possibility of the reconstruction algorithm using with the wavelet transform was researched

articleTitle: The Investigation of Realization Bandpass Impedance Acoustical Active Filters on Saw
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The new method of the designing of active bandpass frequency filters is based on inclusion of one or some SAW interdigital transducers (IDTs) into transistor amplifier cascades as frequency depended circuit's elements is investigated. The different methods of including of one or some IDTs into different circuit's have been investigated. It is theoretically shown that transfer function of such amplifiers can have a form of AF characteristic of bandpass filter but without losses and even with the signal amplification in the pass band and with suppression of outpass band signals no less of 40 dB

articleTitle: Temperature Disribution in Sheet Materials in Microwave Heating Devices Based on the Slow-Wave Structures
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The main questions of flat dielectric materials heat-treatment, located near the slow-wave structures in the running wave field are considered. The analysis of the main equations for calculation of the waited and specific power losses distribution toward spreading microwave energy is organized in rectangular coordinate system. The dependency of the power distribution toward spreading energy direction on deceleration factor and heat-treated dielectric material parameters is shown. The microwave power distribution on the slow-wave structure surface in dependencies on dielectric material parameters, generator wavelength and deceleration factor is presented

articleTitle: Research of the Secondary emission Second Generation in the Multi-Stage Depressed Collectors
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The analysis of the secondary emission second generation in the multistage depressed collectors for TWT is described. The results of the five-stage depressed collector are given

articleTitle: Transient Thermal Processes in Pulse Excited Thin-Film Electroluminescent Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Modeling problems for nonstationary heating of thin-film electroluminescent capacitors for pulse excitation are considered. Heating absence is established for luminophor and substrate. Luminescent film temperature are less 1 K and thickness of heating layer are less 50 mum for 1 ms pulse excitation

articleTitle: Residual Temperature Stresses in Shadow Pyrographite Grids of the Microwave Electrovacuum Devices Arising at Laser Cutting on Different Modes
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Laser processing of pyrographite was carried out on different technological setups by radiation of the solid-state laser with wavelength X= 1.064 mum and pulse duration tau = 4middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3 </sup> s, tau = 1.5middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> s, tau = 1.2middot10 <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> s. The power density of falling radiation was changed in a range 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Residual temperature stresses were studied by the X-ray method. Minimization of residual temperature stresses is determined

articleTitle: The Method of Designing the Wide Band Matching Elements of Slow Wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The method of designing the wide matching elements of slow wave structure based on the synthesis theory of inductively coupled circuits is proposed. The circuit's elements are specified with 3D HFSS 9.0 simulation. The simulation of the coupled cavity TWT structure is done. The results of section TWT matching represented

articleTitle: Modeling of Operation of Scanning Laser Acousto-Optic Microscope with a Sound Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The principles of image creation in scanning laser acousto-optic microscope (LAOM) with sound frequency modulation are discussed with the help of double Fourier- transformation of acoustic field of an object. Some features of the image building are considered. The calculations results are given for an operation a LAOM with sound frequency modulation under certain basic parameters

articleTitle: The Research of the Electronic Efficiency of the Generator on the Double Gap Resonator with Different Length Gaps
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: It has been investigated of electron efficiency of the double gap resonator with gaps different length as oscillator, working on pi-mode of fluctuations. The shown opportunity of achievement electronic efficiency 51%. It was been investigated influence of space charge and gap without a grid on electron efficiency

articleTitle: Ambipolarity Diffusion in a Cross-Section Magnetic Field for Lumpy Plasma of Smouldering Glow
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Mathematical model for lumpy plasma of smouldering glow is introduced. Distribution of ionizing under the different parameters of the spotiness is received

articleTitle: Calculation Frequency Characteristics of Stabilotron
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Results of calculation of stabilotron frequency characteristics carried out on the basis of space charge structures mathematical modeling in amplitron are represented. Comparison settlement and experimental data is lead

articleTitle: Calculation of a Transformation Ratio of a Planar Coupling Loop of the Waveguide Reflective Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The calculation method of a planar coupling loop's transformation ratio of the waveguide reflective phase shifter is considered in view of a dielectric substrate's effect. The transformation ratio is one of major parameters of an equivalent circuit used for simulation of such phase shifter. At calculation the conventional technique of the electrodynamic analysis of the partially-filled rectangular waveguide is applied. The carried out calculations point to a significant field distortion even with thin substrates

articleTitle: The Electron Oscillations Near the Cyclotron Frequency in a Magnetron Diode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The nature of the magnetron diode spatial charge structure is electron selforganization. As shown in the experimental investigation of oscillations near the cyclotron frequency, there are frequencies with different collective natures. Transformation of the frequencies is the result of the bifurcations

articleTitle: Optimization of Choice Ocalization of Exposure During Extremely-High Frequencies Therapy with Mathematical Modelling
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The mathematical model of interaction the energy meridian of human organism for optimization of influence during doing extremely-high frequencies therapy is presented. This mathematical model made with using mathematical methods of automatic control theory

articleTitle: Investigation of Gridded High Perveance Electron Gun
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The 3D modeling results of triple grid high perveance electron gun, beam experimental measurements and it's comparison are presented

articleTitle: Optimization of Desing Data of Slowing Down System of a Chain of the Connected Resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The analysis of the constructive characteristics of slowing down system of a chain of the connected resonators influencing target parameters of the electrovacuum device a lamp of a running wave in a range "X" is carried out(spent). As a result of the carried out(spent) analysis the sizes slowing down system, allowed are optimized to modify target parameters of a lamp of a running wave on width of a strip of working frequencies, on amplification(strengthening), on having pressure(voltage) and currents of electrodes of the electrovacuum device

articleTitle: The General Principles on Shaping of the Test Tasks of the Matrix Type of the More Low Order on Base of the Complex Test Compositions
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the article the procedure for the shaping the test tasks of the matrix type of the more low order on the base of the complex test composition of the matrix type is investigated. For example on the test task (semiconductor diodes), general approaches on making the correct new structures are considered. In the article happens to logistical scheme, which appears the simplified variant for the decision of the task on correspondence. The studies of the new structures on insufficiency, sufficiency and redundancy ensembles are conducted

articleTitle: Effects of Quantization in FFT Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In given article effects of quantization in FFT algorithms associated with representation of handled numbers and coefficients with the limited accuracy are considered. Noise of a rounding off concern to such effects at truncation of results of multiplications, errors of scaling of intermediate results with the purpose of elimination possible overflowing, and also the errors of transformation connected to final accuracy of representation of factors

articleTitle: Calculation of the Third Harmonic Output Power in Broadband TWT
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: 1D computation program of TWT output parameters which allows to calculate third harmonic output power of TWT has been created. Calculation of the third harmonic output power in broadband TWT by analytical formula and 1D and 2D computation programs of TWT output parameters has been conducted

articleTitle: Program Procedures of Shaping Objects in Many Parameter Tasks of Artificial Perception Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article is devoted to program procedures of shaping objects in many parameter tasks of artificial perception systems such as test technology systems

articleTitle: Energetic Characteristics of Systems Transfer Datas with Ultrashort Radiopulsed
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Possibility of creation of ultra-wideband communication systems on the base of ultrashort radiopulses is considered. Questions of energetic characteristics and system are investigated

articleTitle: Diod Multiray Autoemission Electron Gun
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: 19-ray diode electron gun sample based on matrix autoemission cathode (AK) made from glass carbon CU-2000 is produced. The achieved average current density of AK is 0.9 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Multipointed matrix density for the AK is 2.5*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>

articleTitle: A Parallel Connection of the Power Supplies
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this article presented method of parallel connecting the power supplies with three types of equalization: by means of current, temperature and efficiency. Practical results of experiment are also reported

articleTitle: Improvement of Broadband TWT Technical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the report the results of researches on creation of new generation broadband TWT are presented. The basic characteristics are given. The basic ways of improvement of characteristics are shown. They are connected first of all with application of an anomalous dispersion

articleTitle: Simulation of SHF Resonance Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Simulation of SHF resonance gyroscope with the aim of its sensitivity appreciation is considered. The possibility of practical realization of high enough sensitivity gyroscope consisting of SHF impulse voltage generator and circle resonator has been estimated

articleTitle: Calculations of Optical Systems of Light-Emitting Diodes Under Program Tracepro
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the report results of calculations of beam patterns of light-emitting diodes with the various optical systems providing narrow and wide radiation are discussed. Objects of researches had two basic variants polymeric lenses (with a parameter of refraction n = 1,55): lenses with full internal reflection from a lateral surface with the maximal radiation in an axial direction and lenses with circular radiation from a lateral surface with the minimal radiation in an axial direction

articleTitle: Application of Principles of Duality in Power electronics
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article principles transformations of circuits of power electronics with the help of a method dual transformations are considered. The description of a method and its application for the analysis and synthesis of key electronic circuits is resulted

articleTitle: Histeresis Phenomenons in a Magnetron Diode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The space-charge self-organizing modes (oscillations) and cathode back-heating are responsible to hysteresis phenomenons in a magnetron diode

articleTitle: Receiving and Researching Electrical and Physical Properties of Amorphous Superlattices with Quantum Dots Based on SIXC1-X : H / NC-SI : H
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Investigated conditions of receiving nanodimensions crystallites of silicon in microwave plasma of gas discharge of low pressure on noncrystallite substrate with different types of interaction on interphase board. As shown, their formation occurs by infill gaps of initial relief of surface substrate. Established that insertion particles of silicon nanocrystallites in amorphous silicon carbide matrix influence on photoelectric properties received multilayers heterostructures and possess properties of electric active multielectronic centers

articleTitle: Application of Principles of Duality in Not Planar Circuits of Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In article principles transformations of not planar circuits with the help of one method for dual transformations - a bilateral inversion method is considered. The description of the method and its application is given using an example of direct current converter synthesis

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Shottky Diodes Low-Frequency Noise at Direct Current Bias and in a Mode of Detecting VHF Carrier
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Schottky diode LF noise may be sufficiently different at direct bias and in VHF detection mode. Results of LF noise diode computer modeling carried out by means of AWR LtMicrowave OfficeGt using standard SPICE Schottky diode model is not adequate to experimental data in these modes. Advanced Schottky diode noise model including serial resistance fluctuations, noise models of central and boundary areas was simulated using AWR LtMicrowave OfficeGt. The results of this modeling sufficiently better corresponds to experimental data as at direct bias so at VHF detection mode

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation a High-Frequency Hibride Tube with Two Virtual Cathode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A microwave device that has a hot cathode, primary virtual cathode, an accelerating anode, a blanking-pulse electrode, secondary virtual cathode, reflector and a resonator is described in this article. This device will be used in powerful microwave generators

articleTitle: Determination of Parameters a Wideband Klystrode Amplifier with Double-Circuit Output Oscillating System
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Algorithm and program of calculating a klystrode output operation factors is considered. This klystrode has double-circuit output oscillating system. In this article the comparison of calculating data and experimental data are given

articleTitle: About a Electromagnetic Solitons Propertys by using Them in the Radiolocation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The paper is devoted to using of a electromagnetic solitons in the radiolocation. Soliton's properties (preservation of soliton's form in the time of propagation in space) giving a location quality and reliability improvement for location in the radio- or optical (laser) frequency bands

articleTitle: Vacuum Evaporation of Composite Oxides and Durability of Cathodes
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Quasi-equilibrium models of influence of time, temperature and initial composition of oxide-cathodes and aluminate cathodes on the barium content in composite oxides are explored. Increase of calx concentration reduces the activity of oxygen in system "composite oxide - oxide mist" and increases the barium activity, which as a result increases the speed of baryta congruent evaporation. articleTitle: Energy Characteristics of Light Passing Coefficient Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Basing on the model of a compound process, analysis has been made of energy characteristics of the light flow through a blood smear, depending on the form, the sizes, the number and the transparence of erythrocytes

articleTitle: Modeling of Resonator Cambers for Vacuum-Plasma Processing and Thin-Film Covering of Multilayered Planar Substrates
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The rectangular resonator chamber constructions have be proposed and investigated for vacuum-plasma processing and thin-film covering of multilayered planar substrates. The rectangular waveguide aperture and slot antennas have been considered to feed the chamber. The multiaperture, multislot with transverse slots, and single longitudinal slot antennas have been proposed

articleTitle: Evaluation of Traveling-Way Tubes Availability in Active Phased Array Antennas for Digital Television
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: It is shown that active phased array antennas can be well used in broadband digital television in case of designing special traveling-way tubes with low amplification constant, working in nonlinear or saturation mode in order to decrease their phase sensitivity

articleTitle: Emission from Quantum Dots and Lines
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The centers of emission can be places of disturbance outlet, borders of grains and phases, germs of new phases. The barium tendency to segregation on these centers leads to formation of a positive charge (potential) and reduction of work function. In this work the emission from quantum-dimensional structures where the emission is determined by the known equation Richardson-Dashman is compared. Density of emission current from unit of the nominal area of the emitter out of places of disturbance outlet to a surface at disturbance density 2middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> and from borders of grains at the size of grains 10 microns have one order with current density determined by the equation Richardson-Dashman

articleTitle: Analysis Shaping and Decryption principle of the Information Digital Packet Words at Transmission of the Signal on Cable Network of the Power Supply 6,3 kV with Insulated by Neutral Wire
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: To dispose of wrong decryption of the code word, sent on network of supply, the coding and decryption methods was designed, under which hindrance can be not perceived, as start-bit of the next machine word

articleTitle: About Electromagnetic Energy Density and its Velocity
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The simplest dispersion laws for dissipative media, density of electromagnetic energy, phase and group velocities been considered. It has been shown that group velocity may exceed the velocity of light. Also it has been shown that for polar dielectrics with abnormal positive dispersion described by Deby's formula the velocity of energy coincides with phase velocity

articleTitle: Simulation of Kinematic of an Electron Motion in Quadrupole Microwave Amplifier on Adler Device
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The possibility of computer simulation of a potential distribution in quadrupole section of Adler device are considered. The kinematic of driving and configuration of a beam coupling before passing by it of a quadrupole zone of a microwave amplifier is shown

articleTitle: Elements of the Functional Diagnosis in Distributed Cable Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The article describes the construction opportunity of logic model of distributed power cable networks. The developed methods of faulty sites definition are described and an optimum arrangement of control points is offered. Also the diagnostic recursive algorithm of separate network elements is offered. This algorithm allows to be arranged under varied topology of networks

articleTitle: Resonant Self-Focusing and Non-Stationary Coherent Transients Manifestations in Frequency-Modulated Laser Beams Propagation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Periodical modulation of frequency, typical for spectroscopic purposes, is numerically modelled in transversely limited, propagating through a saturable two-level absorber. At modulation periods comparable with the atomic relaxation times the time and frequency dependence of the output intensity exhibits the manifestations of delayed medium response, including time-dependent lens and aperture effects that may be of importance in spectroscopy

articleTitle: Modelling of Nonstationary Dynamics of Resonant Microwave Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of numerical simulations of single-frequency, regular self-modulation and chaotic generation in various microwave devices utilizing electrodynamic system in the form of chain of oscillators have been presented. The investigation of non-stationary processes in multiple-cavity klystron, TWTO, BWO has been conducted. The numerical simulation is based on non-stationary theory of excitation of periodic waveguides. This approach is applicable for various practical problems, such as amplification of multi-frequency signals, parasitic self-excitation of amplifiers

articleTitle: The Experimental Results of Producing Chaotic Radio Pulses by Multicavity Active Oscillator with Delayed Feedback by Means of the Influence of Radio-Frequency Pulse
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The work presents experimental results of producing chaotic radio pulses by multicavity active oscillator with delayed feedback by means of the influence of radiofrequency pulse, delivered in the feedback line. The experiments showed that the initiation of chaotic radiofrequency pulses is possible in the whole zone of amplitude curve (gain characteristic) of autonomous klystron active oscillator. Thus was stated the possibility of klystron active oscillator employment as a source of chaotic radio pulses

articleTitle: Complex Many Level Current Inverter on Base of n-Bridge Circuit with non Transformer Power Summery
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Principle of synthesis of n-bridge s-phase non transformer many level current inverter with complex continuous summary device based on 6-element capacity battery

articleTitle: Particular Qualities of Functioning Communications System by Ultrashort Microwave Pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Propagation features of ultrashort microwave pulses in the passive elements of a microwave tract are studied. Investigations of ultrashort microwave pulses generator and double balanced ultra-wideband phase detector are carried out. Optimal parameters of the communication system elements on the criteria of the minimal distortion of ultrashort pulses are found

articleTitle: Electronic Conductivity of Intermediate Triode-Klystron Resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The electronic conductivity of the intermediate resonator of the triode-klystron driven by sequence of bunches, acting of a triode part of the device in a mode with a cut-off of a cathodic current has been investigated. It was shown that electronic conductivity as against a case of a homogeneous beam essentially depends from a phase variable voltage at which bunches go to gap, or from shift of phases between a voltage and a first harmonic of the induced current, and also from amplitude of a variable voltage. Schedules for definition of electronic conductivity are instanced at a detuning of the resonator aside high frequencies that is necessary for grouping a bunch

articleTitle: The Microprocessor System of Control by Electrical Drive of Fans of Units for Gas Cooling by Air
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: There are described common general structures of control system of electrical drives of fan air cooling units of gas with use of microprocessor controller. This device is working at the test mode at the real object. There are described main functional abilities of control system

articleTitle: About the Schemes of Charge Distribution, Calculation of Force and Self-Action Effect of Particles in Electron-Optic Tasks
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The examples of the particle self-action effect revealing in multidimensional beam modeling tasks are presented

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Quasistationary Calculation of Quasi-H20 Cutoff Wavelength in Double Ridge And Four Ridge Waveguides with Dielectric Material in Capacitance Gaps
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Peculiarities of quasistationary calculation of quasi-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20 </sub> cutoff wavelength in double ridge and four ridge waveguides capacitance gap of which is partially or completely filled with dielectric material are considered. Results of comparison of computation data of normalized transverse wavenumber of quasi-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> wave in four ridge waveguide with dielectric material in capacitance gaps obtained using method of equivalent networks and partial tasks are represented

articleTitle: Local Oscillations in the Limited Periodic Structure Such as a Coupled Cavity Chain
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of an experimental research of influence of discontinuities on fields distribution near to boundaries of a passband and in a stopband of the coupled cavity chains are presented. Local oscillations in the limited periodic structure such as coupled cavity chain, similar by the physical nature Tamm's to surface levels are revealed

articleTitle: The Microprocessor System to Synchronizing and Excitement Turbo Generator of the Highway Transport of Gas Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: There described problems of the microprocessor system to synchronizing and excitement turbo generator of the highway transport of gas enterprise

articleTitle: The Computation Code for Statistical Performances of Traveling-Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The program for computation of statistical performances of traveling-wave tubes is created in view of the spread in construction-technology factors as along the device length, and in their average values from one device to another. In addition to the work, where such an algorithm has been realized, in the present report, besides the spread in slow-wave structure pitch and permittivity of support rods, the spread in PPM parameters is taken into account. Here, the suggested method for storing random numbers is applied to receive more authentic dependencies of output parameters on tolerance values

articleTitle: The Forming of Stable Comb-Like Pulses in an Ensemble of Three-Level Atoms Under Conditions of Λ-Scheme Double Resonance. Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The process of double resonance in atomic vapour of metals is studied numerically. The Λ-scheme of exciting and input pulses with duration 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> sec are considered. It is shown that under these conditions in the major frequency channel (pump) the new type of pulse with comb-like real envelope can arise. In the case of strict resonance in this channel comb-like pulse has the same structure as ordinary 0pi-pulse in the self-induced transparency theory. The distinctive feature of this pulse is the very slight attenuation during its propagation in the medium despite of fact that its duration is compatible with time of irreversible relaxation of quantum transitions.

articleTitle: COM & FEMSDA - Analysis of Saw Devices
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: A modification method of analyzing surface acoustic wave devices using the coupling-of-modes (COM) and FEMSDA- technique is presented. The reflection, transduction, attenuation and coupling between two tracks are included in the model. In this paper, results obtained were presented by development of the universal analysis and modeling technique for various surface acoustic wave devices.

articleTitle: The Prospects of the using Wavelet - Transform for Analysis Information Function in the Test Technology
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the article is briefly stated bases wavelet - transform and the change from Furie - transform, and are considered prospects of the using wavelet transform and wavelet-analysis in test technology.

articleTitle: Super Broadband Frequency Converter with Controlled Amplitude-Frequency Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Scientific and Production Center "Almaz-Phazotron" previously introduced development of the up and down frequency converter functioning in (8-18) GHz frequency range. In this paper the results of the development of the microwave up and down frequency converter in microwave monolithic integrated circuits were introduced. Design scheme, construction units design, main experimental results were shown

articleTitle: An Analysis of Operation the Resonance Converter
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In this article is considered way of raising efficiency one-cycle resonance converter with two-semi-period rectification. Method of the calculation regulation feature and graphics dependency of output voltage from the electrical parameters circuit are also shown

articleTitle: Carry and Inversion of the Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: At processing signals in technics of communication there is a number of the problems connected to transformation of spectral of signals. Some from them are solved with the help of a digital filtration. It is possible to allocate the problems demanding moving of a spectrum of a signal on an axis of frequencies into separate group. Such transformations of a signal are typical in technics of multichannel communication at formation of a group signal with frequency division of channels (FDC) from separate channel signals or at allocation of separate channel signals from a group signal with FDC. Feature of the specified processing is that the peak spectrum of a signal practically does not change. Position of a spectrum on an axis of frequencies varies only

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Frequency Response of the Attenuating and Phase of Attenuating Equalizer for Broadband TWT
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The researches of attenuating and phase frequency response and experimental characteristics of attenuating equalizer have been carried out. This device (equipment) is used to gain equalization in superbroadband TWT. As a result of optimization the design of attenuating equalizer have been developed by means of equivalent schemes. The tuning plungers are tuned each in its natural frequency

articleTitle: Usage of Stereo Projections for Robot Orientation
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The basic conceptions of stereo projections processing: epilines, epipoles, essential and fundamental matrixes are described. The algorithms for a fundamental matrix computation from the correspondent point coordinates of stereo images are discussed. The efficiency of a robust algorithm is illustrated by a practical example

articleTitle: Investigation Model of Multipurpose Technological Device for Vacuum Plasma Treatment Thin Films Deposited on Band Substrate
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Designed, made and researched model of multipurpose technological device for vacuum plasma treatment thin films deposited on band substrate. Calculated and made antenna provided satisfactory agreement with chamber at three loads: 1) chamber without treatment details; 2) chamber with high absorption insulator; and 3) chamber with insulator covered metal

articleTitle: Possibility Making Powerful Relativist Klystron of 3-cm Range with Electronic Efficiency of About 90%
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The results of computer modelling are described on the basis of the previously obtained and experimentally verified data. It is deduced that in powerful relativist klystron of 3-cm range it is possible to realize a regime with efficiency of about 80 % (electronic efficiency 90%) at power of 100-200 MW

articleTitle: The Investigation of Broadband TWT with Anomalous Dispersion in Multisignal Mode
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: The investigation of broadband TWT with anomalous dispersion in multisignal mode has been made. The influence of frequency detuning and of input signal phase changing on the two-signal amplification in the TWT of real construction has been considered

articleTitle: Researches of Light-Emitting Diodes Luxeon Star with Various Polymeric Lenses
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Results of measurements and calculations of radiation patterns of light-emitting diodes Luxeon star with replaceable collimating and diffusing polymeric lenses are discussed

articleTitle: Speeding Up of the Electromagnetic Engine for a Source of Seismic Signals
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: In the report the question on influence of speed of input of energy in a magnetic field of the electromagnetic engine of a pulse source of seismic signals on structure of its power supply system. At duration of input of energy in a magnetic field no more than 40 % from time of operation even the simple power supply system provides the big specific capacity of the electromagnetic engine

articleTitle: Study of Trends of Increasing the Efficiency of TWT
publicationTitle: 2006 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering
abstract: Analytical estimation of accordance the limiting TWT efficiency with electronic efficiency, collector efficiency, microwave loss and kinetic power loss in functional units. The most general functions are shown on curves, it provides to make fast choice of TWT design when developing the tube. The proposed analytical approach can be used to another vacuum devices, klystrons for example
